purpose: 180 MORAI base scenarios for PointPainting and future multi-sensor BEV fine-tuning

environment.note: Use an environment batch manifest to capture.

network_policy.note: Load the Simulator Network once. Each ScenarioLoad restores only the Ego Network from EgoNetwork/<stem>_MN.json.

capture_policy.note: Use rolling-grouped for training data. It sends captures while moving, then groups and verifies Camera/LiDAR/GT artifacts by their shared MORAI timestamp.
